parts.type: Cont r a ⟶ Cont r (Cont r b)
parts.tooltip: fmap f :: Cont r a ⟶ Cont r (Cont r b)\nfmap f m = \\k -> m (\\a -> k (f a))\nWhatever a is produced, the continuation k receives f a — the next Cont — not its result.

parts.type: Cont r (Cont r b) ⟶ Cont r b
parts.tooltip: join :: Cont r (Cont r b) ⟶ Cont r b — the Cont-specific part\njoin mm = \\k -> mm (\\m -> m k)\nWhen the outer step finishes, the inner Cont it produced receives the original continuation k. The current step runs last — this is continuation composition.

ports.tooltip: Cont r a = (a ⟶ r) ⟶ r — a suspended computation waiting for its continuation k
f : a ⟶ Cont r b — user code; given result a, builds the next continuation-based step
Cont r b = (b ⟶ r) ⟶ r — the composed computation; callCC can capture k here for early exit. Never Cont r (Cont r b).
